in_marathi.name: Dhina
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Feminine power, strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhina represents the divine feminine power and strength. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhana' which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Dhina is also associated with the goddess Durga, who is revered as the embodiment of feminine power and strength.
